name: Followthrough
context: Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon, submission 4 Nov 2026 21:00 ET; owners GK and a US partner; all files under app/
problem: Small-business work is a chain of open loops (lead, sample, quote, order, invoice, receipt, stock lot, stall day) scattered across mail, the accounting tool, spreadsheets, Instagram and the owner's head. Nothing flags which loop is going cold, so leads, invoices, receipts, stock, orders and stall days leak, and the owner cannot see cash, owed, stock or what is due. New leads get a blanket approach with no check on whether they sell specialty coffee, at what tier, or whether they already know an existing customer, supplier or stockist. Under UK GDPR the owner is the data controller and the current tools cannot say where a person's data sits, how long it is kept, or how it would be erased.
who_its_for: Owner-operators of small B2B businesses where a sale takes more than one conversation and relationships run through chat and email, 1 to 20 people, no sales or finance staff. User one is GK, solo owner of a small business importing Indian green coffee for UK roasters and a market stall.
outcome: 0. No real person's data is ever handled, and going live would be lawful.
1. Nothing leaks: every loop gets its next move on time without the owner remembering; the owner only decides and approves.
2. Every new lead arrives qualified, tiered and placed in the owner's network before the first message is drafted.
3. At any moment, on any device, the owner can see cash, owed, stock, due today and the background on any lead, and it is right.
4. All of it under an hour a day, from the phone.

tiers.core_4_nov: the 19 rows named in app/workflows.md 'One Core list': Capture A1 to A3, brief L1 with warm leads, invoice chase and payment close, lot low, cash-up, qualify and warm path, soft no and declined, receipt to expense, Ask, Where I stand; engine rules approval, voice file, weekday briefs, Held at delay 0, test recipients, logging
tiers.core_after_4_nov: the remaining Core rows in app/workflows.md including the ported rules: reservations and supplier shortfall, price-list guard, coffee alias, own clocks, stall documents and transport, tax-season Ask, Parked, Auto-reply, Cadence, Offer ladder, Stage, Lapsed, undo

out_of_scope: replacing Zoho Books: bank reconciliation, VAT, HMRC filing, year-end
moving money, paying bills, any bank write
landed cost, customs, duty, courier booking, delivery tracking
helpers, co-runner, second business, roles beyond one shared owner login
real customer data, the current Zoho accounts, any send outside the test lists before live
Glimmer local mode, a real WhatsApp Business number
key_constraints: Every customer-facing send needs owner approval: a tap, a reply 'yes', or a reply/voice transcript the model reads as clear agreement to the quoted card (confidence >= 0.8); a change request edits the draft and issues a new card
Cold = untouched 3 calendar days; invoice cold the day after due; lot low under 20% of starting kg; stall day uncashed if no cash-up by 21:00 Europe/London
Briefs at 08:00 and 18:00 Europe/London on weekdays only; nothing unprompted between or at weekends; owner-requested briefs allowed any time
Approved customer messages are held 60 minutes with undo; DEMO_SEND_DELAY_MINUTES=0 removes the hold and is logged
Drafts are grounded in a signed-off owner voice file (app/data/voice.md); no draft without it
A loop is parked after 3 unanswered chases; any counterpart touch un-parks it
Auto-replies are not touches
Specialty bar: retail price >= GBP 8 per 250g; mid-shelf 8 to 12; premium above 12; below 8 closed with reason
Warm path: 1 or 2 edges from a lead to an existing customer, supplier or stockist; warm leads rank first and the first draft names the connection
Declined counterpart never drafted to again; block covers the organisation's domain, never a shared free-mail domain
No real person's data: synthetic.json only, emails under example.test, WhatsApp recipients on the Cloud API test list, fresh Zoho Mail and Books accounts
Until APP_LIVE=true is set by hand in app/.env, every email goes to the owner's test addresses and every WhatsApp message to the test list
Never move money; Books writes limited to expenses, customer payments, sales and items
Keys only in app/.env; public repo passes a secret scan
One shared owner login for GK and the partner
Evidence output: app/logs/actions.jsonl records every brief, approval, send and Books write with timestamps
Customer channels at Core: email (Zoho Mail) and WhatsApp
ENABLE_JOBS=false and ENABLE_POLLING=false by default. Starting the app or opening the UI does not authorize outbound messages, background ingestion or Books writes.
Missing credentials block dependent provider operations and connected proof while independent implementation continues. Fixtures and local checks never prove external completion.
Drafts offer only what app/data/terms.md allows (offer ladder); cadence and channel per tier from the same file
Capture reads back every item it understood and asks once for missing Core fields

AI: Muse Spark Open on Baseten (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) for text; hosted Muse Spark 1.3 only if image input fails; Meta Voice Transcribe for voice notes; model id and token usage logged on every call
Runtime: Node 22.5 or newer (24 preferred), node:sqlite, ffmpeg-static the only runtime package; ENABLE_JOBS and ENABLE_POLLING default false
A reservation never exceeds free kg; a supplier shortfall reaches every affected counterpart as a draft
A draft with a placeholder or an off-list price is blocked; coffee email always leaves from the coffee alias
Receipts are cold 7 days unbooked; compliance dates 30 days before due; stall days 3 days before with a document unsent, 2 days before with transport unconfirmed
open_questions: T5: Railway URL into APP_URL and the WhatsApp callback after first deploy
T6: Voice Transcribe price (slug, json_object, image input and Voice Transcribe key coverage confirmed 3 and 4 Nov)
T1: dummy Zoho Mail account and fresh Books organisation; WhatsApp test numbers and owner test addresses
Owner decisions: lapsed days, deposit 30 or 50%, FX clause, cold-send cap 20 or 30, retention 12/24/36 months

implementation_decision.source: User selected: Build connected v0; I will configure credentials in app/.env. Guided-mode mechanics resolved by S2 initializer under this instruction.
implementation_decision.scope: All ten Core features FT-01 through FT-10 remain required; this is a connected application, initially run locally.
implementation_decision.credential_checkpoint: Independent source implementation and local isolated checks proceed while the owner configures app/.env. Missing configuration blocks dependent provider operations and connected checks. No mock, fixture, local test, or queued request constitutes external proof.
implementation_decision.external_authority: Building and validation do not authorize external messages or Books writes. Require an explicit owner action in the running UI or unambiguous authenticated reply tied to the exact pending action; synthetic test-recipient and fresh-account boundaries still apply.
